mapper.select: SELECT account_id FROM app_user WHERE account_id=#{accountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ocr_batch SET status='UNKNOWN', stage='UNKNOWN', worker_owner=NULL, lease_until=NULL, error_code='C0001', message='识别执行状态未知，已保留可校对内容；请保留原图', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.select: SELECT request_id AS "requestId", fingerprint, status, stage, completed_tiles AS "completedTiles", total_tiles AS "totalTiles", result_json AS "resultJson", error_code AS "errorCode", message, worker_owner AS "owner" FROM ocr_batch WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT count(*) FROM ocr_batch WHERE worker_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND account_id=#{accountId} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') AND status IN ('RUNNING','CANCELLED')
mapper.update: UPDATE ocr_batch SET status='RUNNING',stage='VALIDATING',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, lease_until=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '5 minutes' WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND worker_owner=#{owner} AND status='QUEUED' AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE ocr_batch SET completed_tiles=#{completed},total_tiles=#{total},stage=#{stage}, result_json=COALESCE(#{resultJson},result_json),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND worker_owner=#{owner} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE ocr_batch SET status=#{status},stage=#{status},result_json=COALESCE(#{resultJson},result_json), error_code=#{errorCode},message=#{message},worker_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND worker_owner=#{owner} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE ocr_batch SET status='CANCELLED',stage='CANCELLED', message='已取消；已发出的模型调用可能仍在结束中',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
UPDATE ocr_batch SET worker_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND worker_owner=#{owner} AND status='CANCELLED'
